g.text: Fixed namespaces with Neo4j Community Edition database semantics
ADR-0116 is PARTLY SUPERSEDED: §1, §4–5, §7–10 out of force (by ADR-0229, ADR-0276, ADR-0307);
Transactions read any namespace and write only `neo4j`
Settings stay in the existing catalog
“Later References: ADR-0142 fills in the SHOW DATABASES fields this ADR left unspecified
(`address`, `role`, `statusMessage`, `writer`) with fixed constants for Neo4j Desktop Browser
“ADR-0229 makes `system_ontologies` listed but not queryable: §1's "Readable with ordinary
Cypher" and §4's 42N18 write gate are superseded — every statement routed there except §2's
“ADR-0116 §8's placement sentence ("stays in `TheaterData.databases`") is superseded by this
ADR; its format and invariant statements stand.”
“ADR-0116 §9, ADR-0117 §7, ADR-0138's "no other `Neo.*` code", ADR-0146's Bolt code and
ADR-0177 item 6's code are superseded the same way.”
“ADR-0554 makes the element-id namespace segment of (7) dash-bearing and short: the writable
namespace's segment is now `rl-id` and the ontology namespace's is `rl-onto` (this ADR's
`cypherlite` spelling predates the product rename; the segm”

4 of the shown cite clauses that are out of force
